§6Purpose and mechanism§r
When a Rock Breaker recipe uses glowstone dust as an input, the dust is not consumed. Other recipe inputs and requirements are unchanged; check the selected recipe before scaling up production.

§3Preparation and operation§r
This change applies only to glowstone dust used as an input by the affected recipe. It neither makes all ingredients reusable nor changes output quantities. Check glowstone separately from the other ingredients and provide output space. When switching recipes, inspect the new input list instead of extending this exception to other consumables.
